sources.entry: Misago - Fully featured modern forum application that is fast, scalable and responsive. (Source Code) GPL-2.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Misago is a self-hostable forum application with a Django backend and React-based frontend, aiming to be a complete, modern internet forum.
summary.what_it_does: Misago provides user registration and profiles, OAuth sign-in with many providers, and spam controls such as custom Q&A challenges, ReCAPTCHA, Stop Forum Spam, and IP blacklists. Forum structure supports categories with unlimited nested subcategories, and posts can be written in GitHub-flavoured markdown, a BBCode subset, or both. It includes a moderation toolset, moderation queues, a ban system, and a rank/role/category-based permission system. Other features include private threads, polls, post attachments with thumbnailing, edit history with revert, best-answer marking for Q&A, custom profile fields, and an OAuth2 client and JSON API for integrations. Development instances are run with Docker, and the frontend is built with webpack and React.
use_cases: host a members-only forum with moderation
set up Q&A threads with best answers
run a forum with social login
build a custom-themed forum with a JSON API
manage user-generated content with moderation queues
how_to_run: Run ./dev init to build Docker containers, install Python dependencies, and initialize the database (development setup)
Run docker compose up to start the development server
docker compose run --rm misago python manage.py migrate
docker compose run --rm misago python manage.py createsuperuser
notable: Supports over 50 OAuth providers for social sign-in
Built-in GDPR compliance features and settings
Post edit log with revert function
Rich polls with private voting, multiple choice, and time-limited voting
caveats: Development status is marked as 'Bananas' in the README, indicating it is early or unstable
Frontend JavaScript has no test suite, per the README
Windows users may hit line-ending errors during Docker setup unless git autocrlf is disabled
Several planned features (plugin system, GraphQL API, WYSIWYM editor, search ranking) are listed as future work
